description: Studio. The operator surface: it drives everything, so it gets the default core permission set — plus, since beta.10, what its own title bar needs: moving the window (the drag region and its double-click), minimize, maximize/restore and close (close goes through the quit guard), and reading whether it is maximized or full screen to draw the right buttons. Decorations and the title-bar style are the host's to change, never the page's.
